desc:
Welcome to Roblox Animation RP

Create your character and roleplay with animations, facial expressions, tools, cars, and customization. Explore the city, go to school, become a police officer, and create your own stories.
 
Tired of Creating Animations or Can't in Studio? 
You are in the correct game, here you can make
variety's of videos on Mobile and PC.

Join The Game Group For Update Notification and Claim a in game free sword.

Special Thanks to Mixamo, Accrobetz Animation,
F1r's studios and Mech Animation for Assisting with 
some animations!

Enjoy the game and Thank you for playing the game

Game Genre : Roleplay, Town & City, Hangout, Cars, Fighting, School, Music, prison, Karate, Animations, Animation, Face, Test, Animation RP, Animation RP, Live Animation RP, Aqua Animation RP, Brookhaven, Brookhaven RP, Life, City, Adventure, Social, House, Avatar, Simulator, Prison, Fight, Police
